channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jrue Holiday | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jrue Holiday from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Joe Cronin on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
“Just the intel work and the study about him as a teammate and a member of a community, I don't have any concerns there. I also have a lot of faith in our environment and our ability to support him. Being around Dame Lillard and Jrue Holiday is a blessing. ... They'll be impactful for Ja in their leadership, in their friendship, in their mentorship. Our organization as a whole, I think we do a good job of supporting players and keeping them in a safe and healthy, respectable environment. So this is a fresh start for Ja and I think he's going to thrive in this environment.”

Joe Cronin on Jrue Holiday, Sep 28, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: AJ Dybantsa on Jrue Holiday, Giannis Antetokounmpo
item.description:
“So he would compare, for example, my lateral movement compared to Jrue Holiday or my vertical jump compared to Giannis [Antetokounmpo]. So I kind of got to see where I was ranked early on in my college career.”

AJ Dybantsa on Jrue Holiday, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Apr 29, 2026. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Devin Booker on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Devin Booker on Jrue Holiday:

“We've competed at the highest level and then competed together at the highest level right after. Someone that I have ultimate respect for. In my opinion, one of the most underrated players to ever play the game. Always enjoy it.”

Devin Booker on Jrue Holiday, Apr 13, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: Micah Shrewsberry on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White
item.description:
“The Jrue Holiday and Derrick White (trades), I’m like, those are Brad guys right there,”

Micah Shrewsberry on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, May 5, 2025. Source: New York Times.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday practicing yesterday:

“He was able to do everything that we worked on. Getting better every day.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday, May 3, 2025. Source: x.com.

item.title: Josh Hart on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
“I said something about egos and y’all took that and ran with it. To win, you have to have a team that don’t have egos. “That’s why Boston won. They have a team that doesn’t have egos. You got Jrue Holiday that’s been an All-Star, All-Defense, All-NBA, max player. He don’t give a damn about scoring. So that’s the ego-less attitude that we have to have. There was no pinpointing somebody. But that’s what you have to have to win.”

Josh Hart on Jrue Holiday, Jan 22, 2025. Source: New York Post.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on teams leaving guys (like Jrue Holiday) open as a defensive strategy:

“Teams got to do magic tricks, try to pull rabbits out of hats to try and beat us.”

Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday, Dec 8, 2024. Source: Bluesky.

item.title: Jason Glushon on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Glushon said, referencing Horford’s free agent deal that summer with the Celtics.

“My oldest tenured client.’’A year later, in 2017, Holiday left Wasserman for Glushon as well. “Everyone has their first, and for me, it’s Al and Jrue,”

Jason Glushon on Jrue Holiday, Oct 22, 2024. Source: Sports Business Journal.

item.title: LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton
item.description:
LeBron on Anthony Edwards:

“That was the best thing about our team. You know, we had the vets—myself, Steph, KD, AD, Jrue Holiday—and then you had the younger guys, Tyrese Haliburton, Anthony Edwards, Devin Booker. Just to see the excitement that Ant-Man played with, showed off the floor, he wanted to compete against everybody. You probably saw him want to compete versus the Team USA ping pong team. He said he could beat people in swimming, you know. He wanted to compete versus everybody. And just to see that electric and that energy from the young guy, and for us as the older guys remembering at one point having all that energy, it was definitely a blessing for sure to be around.”

LeBron James on Jrue Holiday, Devin Booker, Anthony Edwards, Tyrese Haliburton, Sep 21, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Draymond Green on Jrue Holiday, Joel Embiid
item.description:
Draymond Green:

“Really funny story is Joel Embiid tweeting, 'Did the Bucks give them the championship?' Them being Boston. And the answer to Joel's question is yes, they actually did, because they traded Jrue away. And like, I just think even in that trade, like you got to find and do all you can to like keep Jrue because Jrue can guard bigger. So like, there's Jrue can play off the ball or on the ball. Like, there's no fit mismatch with like Jrue and Dame. And I think like, I don't think Portland was hell-bent on getting Jrue Holiday.”

Draymond Green on Jrue Holiday, Joel Embiid, Jun 14, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday:

“He’s brought championship pedigree to our team, so nothing that Jrue says we question.”

Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday, Jun 9, 2024. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Al Horford on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Brian Robb:Al Horford on Jrue Holiday:

“He's just a winner and he stepped up in such a big way for us.”

Al Horford on Jrue Holiday, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Brian Robb:Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday playing through illness:

“I didn't really have to manage (his minutes). I kind of trust him.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday, May 25, 2024. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell
item.description:
Bronny James:

“Guys like Davion Mitchell, Jrue Holiday, and Derrick White who excel in their role, get good money and get good playing time from it because they’re locked into that role and know what they’re supposed to do.”

Bronny James on Jrue Holiday, Derrick White, Davion Mitchell, May 21, 2024. Source: HoopsHype.

item.title: Charles Barkley on Jrue Holiday, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum
item.description:
“They got Tatum, Brown, Jrue Holiday. Your rotation is going to shrink during the playoffs so the bench isn’t as important as you think it is. You got Brown and Tatum two of the best ten players in the league,probably. You got a great leader in Jrue Holiday. You have the best 6th man.”

Charles Barkley on Jrue Holiday, Jaylen Brown, Jayson Tatum, Mar 8, 2024. Source: Booth Newspapers.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown
item.description:
“Yeah, it is. I think I'm better than I was 2 years ago, [Jaylen Brown] is better, [Kristaps Porzingis] makes all the difference in the world, obviously Jrue Holiday.”

Jayson Tatum on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jaylen Brown, Feb 21, 2024. Source: Twitter @ClutchPointsApp.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Michael Malone on Kristaps Porzingis, Holiday:

“Length, shot blocking and a tough matchup ... he can roll with force and handle the ball.”

Michael Malone on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Jan 19, 2024. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Al Horford on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
That included whether he would start, he said, or come off the bench -- a debate that raged in the media around the Celtics throughout the preseason.

“I've just been really impressed with [Holiday's] commitment to the team, to what we're trying to do,”

Al Horford on Jrue Holiday, Nov 22, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jrue Holiday, Suki Hobson
item.description:
Antetokounmpo told The Athletic recently.

“No idea. But I understand why, because Jrue Holiday is my guy. And I don’t want (to be part of that process). I don’t do this. I was lifting weights (at the practice facility) with the strength and conditioning coach (Suki Hobson), and Suki said, ‘Oh!’ (as she looked at the news on her phone). And I said, ‘What’s going on?’ And then she showed me.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jrue Holiday, Suki Hobson, Oct 23, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Derrick White on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis
item.description:
“Adding Jrue Holiday and Kristaps Porzingis, and how close we've been every year since I've been here ... a championship is what we're focusing on.”

Derrick White on Jrue Holiday, Kristaps Porzingis, Oct 19, 2023. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Bobby Manning:Mazzulla on bringing Holiday in off bench:

“We have 7, 8, 9 starters ... the preseason is being able to experiment with different lineups.”

Joe Mazzulla on Jrue Holiday, Oct 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @RealBobManning.

item.title: Paul Pierce on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Jay King:Paul Pierce on Jrue Holiday:

“As far as fit, I feel like he was the missing piece.”

Paul Pierce on Jrue Holiday, Oct 5, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Steve Pagliuca on Paul Pierce, Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Celtics governor Steve Pagliuca on today's practice with Jrue Holiday:

“Paul Pierce turned to us and said he’s never seen an NBA practice in his whole entire career that they went that hard, that fast, for so long.”

Steve Pagliuca on Paul Pierce, Jrue Holiday, Oct 4, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Al Horford on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Jared Weiss:Al Horford on Jrue Holiday:

“He’s somebody I just never would have imagined to be playing next to him. Now that he’s here, I’m excited.”

Al Horford on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday:

“It’s not (a player) that you predict will necessarily have a chance to get. You knew the price was going to be really high, but he’s a guy that we think’s a great fit for us and does so many great things on and off the court for us.”

Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @JaredWeissNBA.

item.title: Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday:

“There’s a list of guys in the league that you always think you’d never have a real chance to get but you think are perfect fits.”

Brad Stevens on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @ByJayKing.

item.title: Damian Lillard on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Dame on defense:

“I'm not gonna come in here and be Jrue Holiday. In my opinion, he's the best perimeter defender.”

Damian Lillard on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @VinceGoodwill.

item.title: Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Antetokounmpo, on Jrue Holiday:

“We're definitely going to miss him... He's always going to be a champion forever. He's always going to be my friend, the best person I've ever met.”

Giannis Antetokounmpo on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @eric_nehm.

item.title: Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday
item.description:
Jaylen Brown:

“I have a tremendous amount of respect for Jrue Holiday…as a competitor he’s an assassin.”

Jaylen Brown on Jrue Holiday, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @BrianTRobb.

item.title: Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday
item.description:
“There's a group of 3 that always a light bulb went off when they're on the court. Jrue Holiday, Tony Allen and Ron Artest.”

Stephen Curry on Metta World Peace, Tony Allen, Jrue Holiday, Aug 1, 2023. Source: Twitter.
